decks.notes: This deck focuses on using control elements to disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining card advantage and board presence through efficient card draw and removal spells. It also utilizes powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Mishra's Bauble to further enhance its control strategies. The addition of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a Companion adds another layer of consistency and value to the deck. Overall, the goal is to outmaneuver the opponent and gradually gain control of the game.

The deck focuses on deploying disruptive creatures to slow down the opponent and control the game, while also utilizing fast mana sources to accelerate its own game plan. By utilizing hatebears like Chancellor of the Annex and Archon of Emeria, along with efficient creatures like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy and win through aggressive beats. The use of Moxen, Mana Crypt, and other fast mana sources allows the deck to quickly deploy its threats and control the board, ensuring victory in Vintage 1 vs 1 matches.

This Dimir Control deck focuses on disrupting opponents with counterspells and removal, while using cards like Urza's Saga and Lórien Revealed to generate card advantage and control the game. It also includes various value cards like Mishra's Bauble and Soul-Guide Lantern to outvalue opponents. The deck aims to slow the game down and grind out wins with powerful control elements like Time Vault and Ancestral Recall. It utilizes the companion Lurrus of the Dream-Den to provide additional value and recursion for key cards.

This deck focuses on utilizing graveyard synergy to quickly generate a large board presence and overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Stinkweed Imp, Ichorid, and Hollow One. By utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Golgari Thug to fill the graveyard, along with spells like Creeping Chill and Noxious Revival to trigger powerful effects, this deck aims to quickly set up a winning board state. Additionally, the deck includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces and ensure its game plan goes off smoothly.

This deck focuses on disrupting opponents' strategies with counter magic and removal spells while deploying threats that can quickly close out the game. With a mix of powerful cards like Force of Will and Oko, Thief of Crowns, along with mana acceleration from the Moxen and Black Lotus, this deck aims to control the board and pressure the opponent's life total efficiently. The combination of disruptive spells, versatile threats, and mana denial through Wasteland makes it a versatile and aggressive deck that can adapt to a variety of matchups.

This deck focuses on playing multiple efficient threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with countermagic and resource denial. The key strategy is to pressure the opponent's life total while controlling the game with powerful spells and disrupting their mana base. The deck aims to win the game quickly by overwhelming the opponent with card advantage and tempo plays, leveraging the Azorius colors' strong interaction and efficient creatures. The deck also has a strong mana acceleration package to cast its powerful threats ahead of schedule and maintain board presence.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize a combination of efficient creatures and disruptive spells to control the tempo of the game while applying pressure on the opponent. By using cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Hullbreacher to disrupt the opponent's mana base and card draw, while deploying threats like Seasoned Dungeoneer and White Plume Adventurer to chip away at the opponent's life total, the deck aims to win the game quickly and decisively. Additionally, access to powerful cards like Ancestral Recall and Tinker allows for explosive plays that can help secure victory.

The deck focuses on playing disruptive creatures that also provide aggro pressure, while also utilizing hate cards to slow down and disrupt the opponent's game plan. It aims to control the board with creatures like Chancellor of the Annex and Archon of Emeria, while also keeping the opponent's resources in check with cards like Wasteland and Karakas. The deck has a fast mana base with artifact acceleration to quickly deploy threats and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck's strategy revolves around disrupting the opponent's plays while beating them down with efficient creatures.

The deck focuses on using control elements such as counterspells, removal, and disruptive spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while assembling a combo with cards like Time Vault and Lórien Revealed to lock the opponent out of the game. It also utilizes card advantage through cards like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to stay ahead in resources. Additionally, the inclusion of Mishra's Bauble and Orcish Bowmasters provides extra value and utility in the deck. The overall strategy is to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent while setting up a game-winning combo.

This deck focuses on generating a large amount of mana quickly using cards like Mishra's Workshop, Moxen, and Mana Crypt, and utilizing cards like Paradoxical Outcome and Mystic Forge to draw through the deck and set up a powerful combo. The goal is to assemble the Time Vault and Voltaic Key combo, or use Tinker to search for key artifacts like The One Ring or Coveted Jewel to create an overwhelming advantage and win the game in a single turn. The artifacts enable powerful synergies and provide immense value, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on using powerful control elements to quickly set up the combo of Oath of Druids to put Atraxa, Grand Unifier into play. It uses cards like Show and Tell and Show and Tell to cheat out expensive creatures, while also having disruptive spells like Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The deck aims to control the game early on and then quickly win by assembling the Oath of Druids combo to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while also applying pressure with efficient threats. It includes a variety of powerful spells like Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, and Oko, Thief of Crowns to control the game and disrupt the opponent's plays. Additionally, it features mana accelerants like Black Lotus and Moxen to quickly deploy threats and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes disruptive creatures like Collector Ouphe and Psychic Frog to further disrupt the opponent's game plan. Overall, this deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent in order to secure a victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's actions through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive permanents like Mishra's Bauble and Lórien Revealed. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while gaining card advantage with cards like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise. The deck also utilizes powerful planeswalkers like Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and utility creatures like Basim Ibn Ishaq to maintain board presence and generate incremental advantage. With a strong mana base including Moxen and powerful lands like Tolarian Academy and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent in a longer game.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game through countering spells, disrupting the opponent's strategy, and generating card advantage. It utilizes a variety of powerful control cards like Force of Will, Flusterstorm, and Consign to Memory, while also relying on disruptive elements like Dress Down and Fatal Push. Additionally, the deck includes powerful draw spells like Ancestral Recall and Treasure Cruise to maintain card advantage. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional synergy and resilience to the deck's strategy.

The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats while disrupting the opponent's game plan. It utilizes powerful artifacts and spells to control the tempo of the game and protect its key pieces. By combining aggressive creatures with efficient removal and countermagic, it aims to pressure the opponent while maintaining card advantage. The inclusion of cards like Lavinia, Azorius Renegade and Hullbreacher further disrupts the opponent's resources and strategies, allowing the deck to seize control of the game and close out matches quickly.

The deck focuses on using Coveted Jewel in combination with various artifacts to generate a large amount of mana and card advantage, allowing for explosive plays and potentially winning the game quickly through combo-ing off with Time Vault. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and other counterspells to protect the combo pieces. The goal is to assemble the necessary pieces quickly and efficiently to overwhelm the opponent before they can react.
